title: headcount-sync-hiring-prep-scratchpad-ava
content:
Purpose: prep notes for upcoming headcount sync (weekly) + interview loop debrief template. Scratchpad — messy.

Meeting: Headcount Sync — Weekly (Mon 10:00am)
Attendees: Priya (People Ops), Ryan (Eng/Platform), Marcus (SRE hiring lead), Ava (note taker)

High-level ask: align on open reqs, priority shifts for Q1 hiring, blockers (budget, interview coverage), and action items for loop debriefs.

Agenda (30 min):
- Quick numbers (5m): open reqs by org, top priorities
- Interview loop capacity (8m): panel availability next 2 weeks, ramp for new interviewers
- Offer pipeline & comp approvals (7m): any stuck approvals? Escalations needed?
- Org planning asks (5m): potential role freezes/reprioritization for late Q1
- Action items (5m)

Current snapshot (as of prep):
- Total open reqs: 18
  - Engineering: 10 (Platform 4, Serving Runtime 3, SRE 2, DevEx 1)
  - Product: 3 (Product mgmt 2, UX 1)
  - Research: 2 (Applied ML)
  - Go-to-market: 3 (Customer Success 2, Sales AE 1)

Priority buckets (suggested):
1) Urgent: Platform infra engineers (x2), SRE (x1) — customer-impacting capacity, risk to Dedicated SLA projects
2) High: Serving runtime engineer (x1), DevEx (x1) — velocity/productship
3) Medium: Product PM (x1), Applied ML infra (x1)

Interview loop status (notes):
- Platform SWE (req PLAT-2026-04) — onsite loop scheduled next Wed. Panel: Ryan, Marcus, Lina.
  - Concern: limited SRE availability for system-design portion. Ask: can Marcus carve 40m? If not, swap with Priya? (no — Priya is people ops)
- SRE (req SRE-2026-01) — 2 candidates in final loop, debriefs pending.
- DevEx (req DEVEX-2026-03) — strong candidate in pipeline, need PM interview added.

Debrief template (use this in Google Form / quick rubric):
- Candidate name / link to resume
- Role & req number
- Interviewer name + round (screen, tech, system-design, culture)
- Score (1-5) on: Technical depth, System design, Ownership & signals, Communication
- Strengths (one-liner)
- Risks / concerns (one-liner)
- Recommend: Strong yes / yes / on-hold / no
- Follow-ups needed (hiring manager, comp, background check)
- Timestamp + interviewer initials

Action items to assign (pre-meeting to confirm):
- Ryan: confirm SRE panel availability for Platform SWE loop by Fri 2/28 — if no, propose alternate panel (owner: Ryan) — due 2026-02-28
- Priya: escalate comp approval for PLAT-2026-04 if candidate steps to offer (owner: Priya) — due immediate when flagged
- Marcus: run debrief on 2 final SRE candidates, consolidate notes into template and flag top choice (owner: Marcus) — due 2026-03-02
- Ava: update headcount tracker (Confluence) with current priorities and annotate reqs with blockers + linked JIRA tickets (owner: Ava) — due 2026-02-28

Notes / things to surface in meeting:
- Budget check: finance said we have 2 flex slots for early Q1 but requires justification — bring product roadmap tie-back for Serving runtime reqs. Link: confluence:Finance-Headcount-Flex
- Interviewer training: new interviewers (2 hires) need calibration session — propose 1-hour calibration Tue 3/4. Action: Priya to schedule and invite senior interviewers.
- Offer velocity: background check vendor has 5 business day SLA — consider approving expedited checks for top-priority hires (cost tradeoff).

Risk list (short):
- Hiring slowdown if we lose top candidate due to offer delay/comps lag
- Interview fatigue — multiple overlapping loops causing panel unavailability next 2 weeks
- Potential freeze request from product leadership if Q1 revenue signals change (scenario planning needed)

Open questions (to resolve before next sync):
- Do we re-prioritize Platform x2 vs Serving runtime x1 if budget drops by one headcount? (ask: Ryan + Eng leads)
- Are there internal transfers (IC to PM) that could fill Product req without external hire? (Priya to check internal mobility list)
- Can we push any non-customer-facing roles to late Q1 to preserve immediate capacity for SLA-impacting hires?

Quick checklist for interview debriefs (to standardize):
- Everyone submits scores within 24h of interview
- Hiring manager consolidates and posts decision + rationale within 48h
- If split decision, schedule sync (max 24h) with hiring manager + 2 interviewers to unblock
- For top candidates, reserve offer slot with finance (notify Priya)

Suggested language for hiring manager note when requesting comp exception: "This candidate has unique infra experience directly tied to our Dedicated SLA commitments — delayed hire risk is high; request priority comp approval to avoid losing candidate."

Quick references (links to paste in meeting doc):
- Confluence headcount tracker: confluence:HR-Headcount-Q1-2026
- Interview loop rubric: confluence:Interview-Rubric-2025
- HR JIRA queue: JIRA:HR-89
- Eng JIRA board: JIRA:ENG-412

Misc scratch / thoughts (brain dump):
- Might propose rotating interviewers: Marcus + Lina rotate for system-design to reduce burnout
- Consider hiring 1 contractor for 3 months for non-customer-facing infra work if headcount constrained
- Note: check hiring score cadence — some interviewers tend to inflate scores; need calibration data (ask research team for distribution)

Post-meeting follow-ups (template):
- Send short summary to #people-ops + hiring managers with decisions + assigned owners (Ava to send) — within 24h
- Update Confluence tracker and tag finance if comp sign-off required
- If offer accepted, create onboarding checklist (IT, access, payroll) and assign buddy

End of scratchpad.

TODO (personal): clean up into shareable doc + add direct links to resumes for candidates in Platform loops.
